issues.description: CC=clang is hardcoded instead of using self.conf.get() — acceptable for makefile projects (see 7zip precedent), but technically violates R33's recommendation to get compiler from Conan conf
issues.fix_suggestion: Could use self.conf.get('tools.build:compiler_executables', {}) but Conan 2.x conf API for sub-keys is version-dependent; hardcoding clang is safe and consistent with repo patterns
